installStep.name: Which werewolf setup do you use?

group.name: Pick the ONE setup you use

plugin.name: Vanilla / FSMP (no TWO, no Growl)
plugin.description:
Pick this if you use neither TWO nor Growl.
Installs OStim_Beast_Form_TWO.esp built WITHOUT TWO's plugin: no Werewolves.esp or MonsterLipSync1.esp needed. It brings its own head-part records and werewolf race head list.
You still need TWO 4.1's files (not its plugin): the male body, skeleton, head parts and textures. Copy them where the PUT_TWO_FILES_HERE.txt notes say. Beast Form ships no body meshes. It is a framework: it uses the stock vanilla paths, so any body set, the Riotguard body pack being the first, or your own, can be installed on top. Without a body set the same paths use TWO's, Growl's or vanilla bodies, so nothing goes missing. Anyone is free to make bodies, patches and hubs on this framework. Vampire Lords need Monster Facial Animation's meshes (PUT_VAMPIRE_LORD_FILES_HERE.txt).
TWO - Total Werewolf Overhaul: https://www.loverslab.com/topic/159911-two-total-werewolf-overhaul/

plugin.name: TWO 4.1, no Growl
plugin.description:
Pick this if you use TWO - Total Werewolf Overhaul 4.1 and do NOT use Growl.
Installs OStim_Beast_Form_TWO.esp (same plugin name and FormIDs as 0.8.x, so saves keep working) and OStim_Beast_Form_TWO - BFA Heads.esp. Beast Form ships no body meshes. It is a framework: it uses the stock vanilla paths, so any body set, the Riotguard body pack being the first, or your own, can be installed on top. Without a body set the same paths use TWO's, Growl's or vanilla bodies, so nothing goes missing. Anyone is free to make bodies, patches and hubs on this framework.
Needs: TWO 4.1 (Core), Monster Facial Animation (MonsterLipSync1.esp). TWO: https://www.loverslab.com/topic/159911-two-total-werewolf-overhaul/

plugin.name: Growl (recommended for Nolvus)
plugin.description:
Pick this if you use Growl - Werebeasts of Skyrim (Nolvus default) and not TWO.
Installs OStim_Beast_Form_Merged.esp (same plugin name and FormIDs as 0.8.x). Adds Growl werebears: MCM option "Werebears use werewolf scenes" (on by default).
Needs: Growl, JS Emissive Eyes SE, Monster Facial Animation (its head meshes). If you also use TWO 4.1, pick the next option. Growl: https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/31245

plugin.name: Growl + TWO 4.1
plugin.description:
Pick this if you use Growl together with TWO 4.1.
Installs the Growl core and also OStim_Beast_Form_Merged_TWO_Patch.esp and OStim_Beast_Form_Merged_TWO_Patch - BFA Heads.esp (same as 0.8.x): TWO's body and heads on Growl werewolves. Beast Form ships no body meshes. It is a framework: it uses the stock vanilla paths, so any body set, the Riotguard body pack being the first, or your own, can be installed on top. Without a body set the same paths use TWO's, Growl's or vanilla bodies, so nothing goes missing. Anyone is free to make bodies, patches and hubs on this framework. Needs TWO 4.1 (Core) with its Growl patch, and Monster Facial Animation (MonsterLipSync1.esp).

plugin.name: Beast couples (optional; animates only with a couple animation pack)
plugin.description:
Start poses for two werewolves (male + female, female + male, two males) and two vampire lords (male + female, female + male), leading to couple menus, plus male-first copies of the male + female couple scenes of the pack they were written for, so they also start from the male side.
These are this mod's own scene files. They were written to play Lirael Atelier's Werewolf and Vampire Lord OStim couple animations (WVLAnimObj.esp) if you still have those files; that pack is no longer available and is not required. Nothing from it is copied or changed. Without a couple animation pack, the buttons don't animate. It is ticked by default only when WVLAnimObj.esp is active.

plugin.name: Icons for the Werewolf and Vampire Lord scene packs
plugin.description:
Installs 10 icons (and 2 spare ones) at the shared icon paths that Werewolf and Vampire Lord OStim scene packs point at, so their menu buttons show pictures. This mod's own 33 icons are always installed in its own folder; this option only fills the shared paths.
Leave it unticked if another mod already provides those icons (the original OCreatures does, and so does OCreatures Reforged); it is ticked by default only when OCreatures.esp is not active.

plugin.name: Use Riotguard/custom bodies even with OCR
plugin.description:
Only usable when OCreatures Reforged is active. Tick it if you want the bodies at the stock paths (the Riotguard body pack, TWO, or your own) instead of OCreatures Reforged's own female werewolf body. Unticked is the safe default.
This option installs only a small flag file that sets the MCM default (MCM > Interop > Body priority). It does not change anything else. You must also set, in OCreatures Reforged's OWN ini file (SKSE\Plugins\OCreaturesReforged.ini): bBody=0 Beast Form never edits that file. Run the game once to confirm. Whether every OCR piece steps aside for custom bodies was not tested in game.

group.name: Which OCum script do you use?

plugin.name: Standard OCum script (install nothing)
plugin.description: Keep OCum's own script. Pick this if you don't use Tull Animated Creampie, Liquid Pack v2 or GT Softbody with OCum.

plugin.name: Tull Animated Creampie / Liquid Pack (no GT Softbody)
plugin.description: My OCum + Tull/Liquid script (same as the 1.0.3 Softbody / Tullius patch): adds Tull Animated Creampie / [Predator] Liquid Pack v2 support with the Scene Change Fix and keeps OCum's own urethra adjustment. Needs the OCum Tull/Liquid add-on: https://dwemermods.com/mods/5304 Put this mod BELOW that add-on in MO2 so this script wins.

plugin.name: GT Softbody (with or without Tull / Liquid)
plugin.description: My OCum + Tull/Liquid + GT Softbody merged script (same as the 1.0.3 Softbody / Tullius patch): adds GT Softbody's two OCum fixes and, if present, Tull / Liquid support. The OCum urethra adjustment is removed because it breaks SMP collision with GT Softbody. Tull / Liquid add-on: https://dwemermods.com/mods/5304 Put this mod BELOW GT Softbody and the OCum add-ons in MO2.

plugin.name: I have read and understand
plugin.description:
FINAL, ABANDONED RELEASE (1.1.1). This mod ships no sex animations and no body meshes, so on its own it does nothing for sex scenes; you need a werewolf / Vampire Lord OStim animation pack (or community-made scenes). Lirael Atelier's pack is no longer available and was never a hard requirement. See the README for the full notice.
PERMISSIONS: anyone may modify, reupload, fork or build on this mod, as long as the existing permission credits (Billyy, Frosferes and any other credited authors) stay in place. Provided as-is, with no further support.
I have read every option in this installer and didn't just click through. If I picked the wrong options, the mod won't work.
Bodies: Beast Form ships no body meshes. It is a framework: it uses the stock vanilla paths, so any body set, the Riotguard body pack being the first, or your own, can be installed on top. Without a body set the same paths use TWO's, Growl's or vanilla bodies, so nothing goes missing. Anyone is free to make bodies, patches and hubs on this framework. The Riotguard body pack is a separate download; install it below Beast Form in the MO2 left pane so its meshes win at the stock paths.
Decided for you from the plugins that are active right now (enable your plugins BEFORE installing, or reinstall): - This mod's own werewolf and vampire lord start poses (the "OCrWerewolfIdle..." menu names other packs look for) install only when no OCreatures plugin is active (neither OCreatures.esp nor OCreatures Reforged - Menu.esp). - If OCreatures (original or Reforged) is installed, overlapping features step aside (start key, beast timer, beast cum load, SkyrimNet state, size menu, combat pause). MCM > Interop shows who does what and lets you override it. - The OCum script page appears only when OCum.esp is active.
Not included, and why: this mod only ships files I made or changed (head expression files, plugins, scripts, scene files, icons, the OCum werewolf node and a small sheath add-on for Growl + TWO). Untouched TWO, Vampire Lord (Monster Facial Animation) and werebear files are not shipped. Folders where they go have a PUT_..._FILES_HERE.txt note that says what goes there and where to get it.
This mod ships no sex animations and doesn't change any animation pack (OCreatures, OCreatures Reforged, Billyy, Baka, FunnyBiz, FlufyFox, or any other). You need a werewolf / Vampire Lord OStim animation pack (or community-made scenes) for sex scenes; their scenes show up through OStim's normal werewolf / vampire lord types.
After installing: run Pandora (or your behavior engine) again.
Known incompatibilities (as of this release): - Diverse Werewolves Collection SE by opusGlass: the camera locks to the sides. Leave it off with this mod. - HDT Werewolves: keep it off (its plugin is also called Werewolves.esp).
Credit: That Guy (Coronerra). Source code: https://github.com/Coronerra/OStim-Beast-Form
